en.headline: Mak says three-tier building-dispute system will start next year
en.dek: The home affairs chief told lawmakers a three-tier system, with early district-councillor involvement and professional mediation, is planned for next year.
body: Secretary for Home and Youth Affairs Alice Mak said on Friday that a three-tier mechanism for handling building-management disputes would be introduced next year, RTHK reported.

Speaking in the Legislative Council debate, Mak said the government was still working on further amendments to the Building Management Ordinance, with a target of submitting proposals to the legislature within this year. The new mechanism, she said, was meant to use early involvement by district councillors and professional mediation to help neighbours deal with management disputes.
She added that the joint building-management scheme would continue in 2027/28 in all districts that need the service, for a further two years.
Mak also said Care Teams had set up service points, handed out supplies and visited older residents during sudden power and water outages in several districts.

zh.headline: 麥美娟：明年推大廈管理糾紛三層機制
zh.dek: 民政及青年事務局局長表示，明年會推出三層機制，由區議員及早介入並配合專業調解，處理大廈管理糾紛。
body: 港台報道，民政及青年事務局局長麥美娟周五表示，明年會推出處理大廈管理糾紛的三層機制。
麥美娟在立法會發言時說，當局正進一步修訂《建築物管理條例》，目標是今年內向立法會提交建議。她表示，三層機制希望透過區議員及早介入和專業調解，協助鄰里處理大廈管理糾紛。
她又說，2027/28年度會繼續在所有有服務需要的地區推行「聯廈聯管」計劃，為期兩年。
麥美娟並提到，多區大型停電和停水時，關愛隊曾到場設置服務站、派發物資，以及為長者或有需要人士送水或探訪。
